## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `aws-marketplace-mpe-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create an IAM user

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the [AWS Management Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to IAM (Identity and Access Management). -->
3. Select **Users** in the left sidebar, then select **Create user**.
4. Enter a user name (for example, `ballerina-mpe-connector`).
5. Select **Next**.
6. <!-- manual: Enter a user name (for example, ballerina-mpe-connector) and select Next. -->
7. Select **Attach policies directly**.
8. <!-- manual: Search for and attach the AWSMarketplaceGetEntitlements managed policy, or create a custom policy granting aws-marketplace:GetEntitlements. -->
9. Select **Next**, review the settings, and select **Create user**.
10. <!-- manual: review the settings -->

## Step 3: Generate access keys

1. <!-- manual: In the IAM console, select the user you created. -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to the Security credentials tab. -->
3. Under **Access keys**, select **Create access key**.
4. Select **Application running outside AWS** use case.
5. Select **Next**.
6. Optionally add a description tag, then select **Create access key**.
7. <!-- manual: Copy the Access key ID and Secret access key. -->

## Step 4: Identify your AWS region

1. <!-- manual: Determine the AWS region where your Marketplace product is registered. -->

## Step 5: Obtain your product code

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the [AWS Marketplace Management Portal](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/). -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Products and select your product. -->
3. <!-- manual: Locate the Product Code in the product details — this is the identifier you pass to the getEntitlements operation. -->
